description:
Change how a campaign uses its number pool. Send only the fields you
want to change. At least one field is required.

This works while the campaign status is `draft`, `scheduled`,
`in_progress`, `waiting`, `paused`, `auto_paused` or `retry_scheduled`.
Any other status is refused with `Cannot edit rotation for status:
<status>`. To change which numbers are in the pool, use the numbers
endpoints.

(Tags: Bulk calls)

bulk_call_id.description: Id of the bulk call campaign.

call_back_from_different_number.description:
When on, a repeat call to the same person goes out from a
different number than the one that called them last. Needs
two or more numbers in the pool. Must be `true` or `false`.

calls_per_number.description: Calls before moving on. Used by `fixed_count` and `both`.

fallback.description:
When every number is unhealthy: `pause` the campaign, or
`continue_best` with the healthiest one.

health_threshold.description:
Health score below which a number is rotated away from.
Used by `cpr_threshold` and `both`.

skip_known_invalid_numbers.description:
When on, a contact is not dialed if the carrier said its
number does not exist, in any campaign of your organization
in the last 14 days. Must be `true` or `false`.

strategy.description:
When to move to the next number: every `calls_per_number`
calls, on low health score, both, or never.

name: setBulkCallRotation
